issues.description: The task requests the ID, name, art and URL of Freibäder, but the solution aliases the name column as id (SELECT name as id, name, art, url). This maps the requested 'ID' to the wrong column (name) and yields a duplicated name column instead of the actual identifier. Students will be confused which actual identifier to return and may follow the incorrect example. The template query (SELECT * FROM Schwimmbad) implies an actual id column likely exists, so aliasing name as id in the solution is inconsistent with the problem intent.
issues.suggestedFix: Return the actual identifier column from the Schwimmbad table instead of aliasing the name. For example: SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art = 'Freibad'; If the identifier column has a different name (e.g. schwimmbad_id or gemeinde_id), use that real column name in the SELECT to match the problem statement.
